name: io.fluf/mcp
description: Manage a FLUF resale account from an AI agent: inventory, crosslisting and unified orders.

environmentVariables.name: FLUF_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal access token from https://fluf.io/connect/settings (Developer tab). Requires an active FLUF plan.

environmentVariables.name: FLUF_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API host. Defaults to https://fluf.io.
